title: Test 1 — Data Inspection
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing data. Perform an initial data exploration: number of rows and columns, column names, data types, missing values. Summarize your findings.
model_output: Correct row/column counts (545 x 13), correct dtypes, correctly reports zero missing values. Also mislabels the 'prefarea' column as "str (prefecture/region)" -- the dataset's naming pattern (mainroad, guestroom, basement, hotwaterheating, airconditioning) strongly indicates prefarea is a binary yes/no 'preferred area' flag, not a geographic region.
verdict: PARTIAL -- correct core stats, but a fabricated/incorrect column interpretation, reached only after an extreme retry storm
notes: 83 tool calls (41 exec, 25 write, 17 read) and ~6.2 minutes elapsed before landing on a working script -- extreme trial-and-error even though the eventual output was reasonable.
prefarea mislabeled as 'prefecture/region' -- a fabricated interpretation of a real column, inconsistent with the dataset's own binary-flag naming convention used for every other yes/no column.

Two separate model.completed usage entries logged (484,669 then 2,622,652 tokens) for what was presented as a single-prompt turn -- likely an internal continuation after hitting a length boundary mid-turn, not a second user exchange. Token totals here are summed across both entries.
